sky.name: Queen's Purse
sky.text: Every hero takes 1 coin from the supply.

sky.name: Feast at the Castle
sky.text: Every hero heals 2 toughness markers.

sky.name: Lucky Stars
sky.text: Every hero rolls one green die. On an attack, take 2 coins. On a blank, heal 1 toughness.

sky.name: Gaol Break
sky.text: Every hero in the dungeon walks free at once, no fee.

sky.name: Muster of Avel
sky.text: Every hero rolls one green die and takes 2 coins for each attack symbol.

sky.name: Moonlit Dew
sky.text: Every hero heals 1 toughness marker.

sky.name: Forge Sparks
sky.text: Upgrade one item, on any hero, for free.

sky.name: Spirit's Gift
sky.text: Draw one equipment token from the bag and give it to any hero.

sky.name: Sharpened Blades
sky.text: This round every hero rolls one extra green die in their first battle.

sky.name: Second Breath
sky.text: One hero of your choice takes a third action this round.

sky.name: Dwarven Discount
sky.text: This round the first wall or moon seal costs 1 coin instead of 3.

sky.name: Old Map
sky.text: Reveal one face-down tile of your choice now. If it has a lair, place a monster as usual.

sky.name: Quiet Woods
sky.text: This round resting restores 3 toughness markers instead of 2.

sky.name: Jewel Flare
sky.text: Put 1 damage marker on any one monster on the board.

sky.name: The Watch Patrol
sky.text: Every hero rolls one green die. Any hero who rolls no attack symbol is dragged to the castle dungeon: move their pawn to the castle. They take no actions until another hero pays 2 coins to the supply.

sky.name: Contest of Arms
sky.text: Every hero rolls 2 green dice. Whoever rolls the most attacks upgrades one item. Ties share the prize.

sky.name: Foot Race
sky.text: Every hero rolls one green die. Each hero with an attack symbol may move one tile at once, for free.

sky.name: Tithe
sky.text: Every hero gives up 1 coin or 1 item, their own choice.

sky.name: Trade Winds
sky.text: Each hero may swap one backpack item with any other hero, no matter where they stand.

sky.name: Wandering Merchant
sky.text: A pedlar walks the roads. This round any hero may buy an item for 3 coins wherever they stand: pay and draw from the bag.

sky.name: Fog on the Hills
sky.text: No shortcuts this round.

sky.name: Wandering Spirit
sky.text: Roll 2 green dice. Two attacks: take 4 coins. One: take 2 coins. None: one hero loses 1 toughness.

sky.name: Bargain
sky.text: One hero may put an item back in the bag and draw a new one.

sky.name: Restless Beasts
sky.text: Move one small monster one tile in any direction.

sky.name: Tax Day
sky.text: Every hero who has a coin pays 1 coin to the supply. Anyone who cannot pay loses 1 toughness.

sky.name: Sprite Plague
sky.text: Every hero loses 1 toughness unless they pay 1 coin to the supply.

sky.name: Press Gang
sky.text: Every hero rolls one green die. Every hero who rolls no attack is thrown in the dungeon and stays there until another hero pays 2 coins.

sky.name: Empty Larders
sky.text: No hero may rest this round. Heroes on the castle tile may still rest.

sky.name: Rockslide
sky.text: The quarry is closed this round.

sky.name: Sour Elixirs
sky.text: No elixirs may be drunk this round.

sky.name: Monster Cunning
sky.text: This round every monster rolls one extra purple die, if one is free.

sky.name: Rusted Gear
sky.text: Each hero puts a used-equipment marker on one item of their choice. It cannot be used this round.

sky.name: Slow Morning
sky.text: The starting player takes only 1 action this round.

sky.name: Creeping Dark
sky.text: Place one small monster on a face-up lair tile of the players' choice.

sky.name: Stolen Supplies
sky.text: Put one item from any backpack back in the bag. The players choose which.

sky.name: Wounded Pride
sky.text: Every hero at full toughness loses 1 marker. Wounded heroes are spared.

sky.name: Shuttered Workshop
sky.text: The alchemist workshop is closed this round.

sky.name: Empty Stalls
sky.text: The marketplace is closed this round.

sky.name: Curfew of the Black Moon
sky.text: Every hero who ends this round on a tile with a monster loses 2 toughness.

sky.name: Highwaymen
sky.text: Every hero rolls one green die. Every hero with no attack symbol loses 2 coins, or an item if they have no coins.

sky.name: Moon Shard
sky.text: Place one small monster on the tile nearest the castle that has no monster on it.

sky.name: Something Awakens
sky.text: Place one big monster on a face-up lair tile of the players' choice.

sky.name: Dark Blessing
sky.text: Remove 1 damage marker from every wounded monster on the board.

sky.name: Monster Fury
sky.text: This round every monster swaps one purple die for a black die.

sky.name: Broken Wall
sky.text: Remove one built wall marker from the game. If there are none, every hero loses 1 coin.

sky.name: The Beast Stirs
sky.text: If the Beast is on the board, turn its dial up by 2. If not, every hero loses 1 coin.

sky.name: Sprung Trap
sky.text: Remove one placed trap from the game. If there are none, no hero may rest this round.

sky.name: Thieves
sky.text: The team returns 3 coins to the supply. The players choose who pays.

sky.name: Swarm
sky.text: Place a small monster on every empty face-up lair tile without a moon seal.

sky.name: Steady Aim
sky.text: Every ballista on the board fires twice this round.

sky.name: Restocked Cart
sky.text: Put the 3 items on the flea market back in the bag and draw 3 new ones.

sky.name: Loyal Beasts
sky.text: Flip every used animal companion token back to its first side. If none were used, every hero heals 1.

sky.name: Bargain Hunters
sky.text: This round a hero at the flea market may make two exchanges with one action.

sky.name: Tangled Cords
sky.text: No ballista fires this round.

sky.name: Worn Soles
sky.text: Shoes give nothing this round, upgraded or not.

sky.name: Empty Cart
sky.text: Return one item from the flea market to the bag without replacing it.

sky.name: The Daughters Whisper
sky.text: Envy, Greed and Wrath are listening. Every hero takes 1 damage that cannot be blocked in any way.

tavern.name: Wolf Bounty
tavern.task: Defeat 2 small monsters.

tavern.name: The Big One
tavern.task: Defeat a big monster.
tavern.reward: Draw an item, then upgrade one item

tavern.name: Marked Prey
tavern.task: Point at any monster on the board now. Defeat that one.

tavern.name: Cartographer
tavern.task: Reveal 2 new tiles.

tavern.name: Deep Scout
tavern.task: Be the hero furthest from the castle when a round ends.

tavern.name: Stonework
tavern.task: Build a wall at the quarry.

tavern.name: Locksmith
tavern.task: Seal a lair at the stone circles.

tavern.name: Trapper
tavern.task: Set a trap at the elven camp.

tavern.name: Alchemy Lesson
tavern.task: Upgrade an item at the alchemist workshop.

tavern.name: Lake Offering
tavern.task: Make an offering at the wishing lake.

tavern.name: Courier
tavern.task: Come back to the castle from at least two tiles away carrying 4 or more coins. You keep them.

tavern.name: Brave Heart
tavern.task: Win a battle with 2 or fewer toughness markers left.
tavern.reward: Heal to full and draw an item

tavern.name: Clean Sweep
tavern.task: End a round with no monster on any tile touching the castle.

tavern.name: Toolsmith
tavern.task: Wear a weapon, a shield and a helmet at the same time.

tavern.name: Elixir Run
tavern.task: Carry 2 elixirs in your backpack at once.

tavern.name: Trophy Hunt
tavern.task: Defeat a monster without losing a single toughness marker.

tavern.name: Salvage
tavern.task: Sell an item at the marketplace.

tavern.name: Nightwatch
tavern.task: Spend a whole turn, both actions, on the castle tile.
tavern.reward: Heal to full and take 2 coins

tavern.name: Merchant's Favour
tavern.task: Buy something at the marketplace.

tavern.name: Pathfinder
tavern.task: Travel by shortcut.

tavern.name: Empty Lair
tavern.task: Stand on a lair tile with no monster on it when a round ends.

tavern.name: Gaoler's Errand
tavern.task: Pay the fee to free a hero from the dungeon.

tavern.name: Last Stand
tavern.task: Fight the Beast at least once. Only after the Black Moon has risen.

tavern.name: Helping Hands
tavern.task: End a round on the same tile as another hero, not the castle.

tavern.name: Generous Hero
tavern.task: Give an item or a coin to another hero.

tavern.name: Monster Slayer
tavern.task: The team defeats 3 monsters in one round.

tavern.name: Trouble at the Quarry
tavern.task: A small monster has settled in the quarry and the masons have downed tools. Draw a small monster, put it on the quarry, and drive it off.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus one wall built for free

tavern.name: The Elven Camp Burns
tavern.task: A big monster is loose in the elven camp. Draw a big monster, put it on the camp, and defeat it.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus one trap set for free

tavern.name: Circle of Broken Stones
tavern.task: Something squats in the stone circles and Theodore cannot work. Draw a small monster, put it there, and clear it out.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus one moon seal for free

tavern.name: Fire in the Workshop
tavern.task: A small monster is drinking Master Vial's elixirs. Draw a small monster, put it on the alchemist workshop, and stop it.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus 2 free upgrades

tavern.name: Market Day Ruined
tavern.task: A big monster is eating the stalls. Draw a big monster, put it on the marketplace, and deal with it.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus one free item from the bag

tavern.name: Something in the Lake
tavern.task: The water spirits have gone quiet. Draw a small monster, put it on the wishing lake, and beat it.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus 4 coins

tavern.name: Wall Crawler
tavern.task: A small monster is picking at the castle walls. Draw a small monster and put it on a tile touching the castle. Defeat it before the round after next, or it takes a wall marker with it.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus 3 coins

tavern.name: The Sleeping Giant
tavern.task: A big monster blocks the abandoned village. Draw a big monster, put it there, and defeat it.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus an item and an upgrade

tavern.name: Siege Engineer
tavern.task: Buy a ballista at the dwarven workshop.

tavern.name: Gunner's Pride
tavern.task: Let a ballista land the killing shot on a monster.

tavern.name: Horse Trader
tavern.task: Exchange an item at the flea market.

tavern.name: Harvest Hand
tavern.task: Take the coins at the fields and forests.

tavern.name: Tamer
tavern.task: Defeat one of the Three Daughters.

tavern.name: Well Shod
tavern.task: Wear a pair of upgraded shoes.

tavern.name: Trouble at the Flea Market
tavern.task: A big monster is rifling through the cart. Draw a big monster, put it on the flea market, and drive it off.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus a free exchange and 3 coins

tavern.name: Winches and Teeth
tavern.task: A small monster is loose in the dwarven workshop. Draw a small monster, put it there, and clear it out.
tavern.reward: The monster's own loot, plus 2 coins off your next ballista

march.name: The Masons Return
march.text: Build one wall for free, if a wall marker is still in the box.

march.name: Holy Ground
march.text: Choose one monster. It does not move at the end of this round.

march.name: Frozen Claws
march.text: The Beast does not move at the end of this round.

march.name: Rallying Cry
march.text: This round every hero rolls one extra orange die in every battle.

march.name: Sharpened Stakes
march.text: The next trap to trigger deals 2 extra damage.

march.name: Echoing Horn
march.text: This round you may reroll one monster die in each battle.

march.name: Crooked Paths
march.text: This round the players choose each monster's path even when it is not the shortest, as long as every monster still ends up closer to the castle.

march.name: Traps Jam
march.text: Traps do nothing this round.

march.name: Blunted Blades
march.text: This round each hero rolls one fewer die of their choice, never going below 2 green dice.

march.name: No Rest for the Brave
march.text: No hero may rest this round.

march.name: Dark Chorus
march.text: This round every monster rolls one extra purple die, if one is free.

march.name: Choked Roads
march.text: No shortcuts this round, for heroes or monsters.

march.name: Double March
march.text: Every small monster moves 1 extra tile at the end of this round, unless that move would take it onto the castle tile.

march.name: Forced March
march.text: Every big monster and the Beast move 1 extra tile at the end of this round, unless that move would take them onto the castle tile.

march.name: Beast Rage
march.text: Turn the Beast's dial up by 4.

march.name: Shattered Astrolabe
march.text: Every hero takes only 1 action this round.

march.name: Black Rain
march.text: Every hero loses 1 toughness now and no hero may rest this round.

march.name: Cracked Mortar
march.text: The next monster to strike the walls destroys 2 wall markers instead of 1.

march.name: Wall Breach
march.text: Remove one built wall marker from the game. If there are none, turn the Beast's dial up by 3.

march.name: Iron Hide
march.text: This round the first 2 damage markers that would go on the Beast in each battle are ignored.

march.name: Blind Fury
march.text: This round every monster swaps all of its purple dice for black dice, as far as the dice allow.

march.name: Shattered Seal
march.text: Remove one moon seal from the board and place a small monster on that lair.

march.name: Swallowing Dark
march.text: Remove one placed trap and one moon seal from the game.

march.name: Crater Bloom
march.text: Place 2 small monsters three tiles from the castle.

march.name: Beast's Roar
march.text: Every hero within two tiles of the Beast is pushed one tile away from it. The players choose the direction.

march.name: Terror
march.text: No hero may start a battle with the Beast this round.

march.name: Broken Blades
march.text: Every hero puts a used-equipment marker on their weapon. It cannot be used this round.

march.name: Kurodar Watches
march.text: This round no hero may use helmet effects.

march.name: Gathering Storm
march.text: Place a small monster on the tile the Beast started from. If the Beast has moved on, place it three tiles from the castle.

march.name: Word from the Walls
march.text: The guards shout news from the battlements. Every hero may reroll one die once this round.

march.name: Dwarven Volley
march.text: Every ballista fires twice this round.

march.name: Jammed Winches
march.text: This round each ballista fires only if the hero who bought it pays 1 coin.

march.name: Sabotage
march.text: Remove one ballista from the board and put it back in the box.

march.name: Three Daughters Ride
march.text: Every hero takes 1 damage that cannot be blocked, and no hero may rest this round.

powers.name: Storm Finger
powers.text: Point at any monster anywhere on the board. Roll 2 green dice: each attack symbol puts 1 damage marker on it. If that finishes it off, take the reward on its token.

powers.name: Moon Step
powers.text: Move your hero to any face-up tile. This is not an action.

powers.name: Silver Ward
powers.text: In one clash, ignore every monster die. Say it before the dice are rolled.

powers.name: Forge Blessing
powers.text: Upgrade any one item on any hero, for free.

powers.name: Mason's Word
powers.text: Build one wall for free, even after the masons have left. Only if a wall marker is still in the box.

powers.name: Frostbind
powers.text: Choose one monster. It does not move at the end of this round. It works on the Beast too.

powers.name: Second Wind
powers.text: Take one extra action this turn.

powers.name: Echo of Dergar
powers.text: In one clash, reroll all of your dice once.

powers.name: Jewel Light
powers.text: Heal one hero to full toughness, wherever they stand.

powers.name: Hunter's Mark
powers.text: For one whole battle, roll one extra orange die in every clash.

powers.name: Dungeon Key
powers.text: Free any hero from the dungeon at once, without paying the 2 coin fee.

powers.name: Gale Step
powers.text: Push one monster one tile away from the castle.

powers.name: Dwarf's Favour
powers.text: Every ballista on the board fires once, right now. Toolkit only: if there are none, take 4 coins instead.

gifts: Draw one item from the bag
Draw an item and hand it to another hero
One free upgrade for any hero you choose
wonders: Upgrade every item you are wearing
Point at any small monster on the board and remove it from the game
Roll 2 green dice and put a damage marker on any monster for each attack symbol, then draw an item
Every hero heals to full and takes 2 coins
